clauses.L1: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of annual leave per year. Leave requests should be submitted at least 14 days before the start date.
clauses.L2: Employees may take up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for absences of more than 3 consecutive days.
clauses.L3: Eligible employees may take up to 26 weeks of paid parental leave.
clauses.S1: Employees with 10 or more years of service accrue 25 days of annual leave per year.
clauses.C1: Complaints about workplace conduct can be raised with Employee Relations. The complaint will be acknowledged within 2 working days.
clauses.C2: Formal complaints are investigated by someone independent of the team involved. Complainants may bring a support person to any meeting.
clauses.H1: Any hazard that could cause injury must be reported to Health and Safety immediately. Report serious hazards by phone, then submit a written hazard report within 24 hours.
clauses.H2: Near misses should be reported within 5 working days using the hazard report form.
clauses.R1: A hiring request must be approved by the department head and submitted to Recruitment with a position description. Recruitment will respond within 5 working days.
clauses.R2: Fixed-term roles of more than 12 months require finance approval before advertising.
clauses.G1: Employees may request flexible working arrangements after 6 months of service.
clauses.G2: The HR service desk is open Monday to Friday, 8:30 to 5:00.
